failures.description: semantic-stack: the Step5 stack exited before readiness. The reserved ngrok domain rose-rose.ngrok.app was online in another deploy's Blacksmith VM (ERR_NGROK_334; every runner's checkout directory is "rose") and three Cloudflare quick-tunnel fallbacks never routed within 45 s. The gate passed on identical tests in rounds 2 and 3 of this deploy; this PR changes no tunnel code.
failures.evidence: ngrok API endpoints list showed https://rose-rose.ngrok.app online from tunnel session ts_3Ln5zl5PemnynzKL77q5cf4Ptxy (ip 192.240.237.126) created 18:47:35Z, after this gate started at 18:46:54Z; GitHub Actions listed Deploy gate jobs of three other deploys running then. Gate artifact: remote-artifact/files/.context/deploy-smoke.log lines 66-107.
failures.assigned_reason: The deploy owner keeps the repair: rerun the gate alone once the shared domain is free; no waiver, no credit.
failures.assigned_evidence: docs: memory blacksmith-gate-flakes-pr1747; ngrok endpoints API response at 18:53Z

failures.description: agents-coverage-blackbox: 124 of 125 domains passed; domain benchmark failed one test, cloudbench_dependency_sync_test.py::test_refresh_deps_applies_exact_workspace_before_rebuild[peer_refreshed] (expected "reusing snapshot snap-peer"). The scenario reuses a peer snapshot only if int(mtime of the state file) >= the integer clock second read before the lock; coarse kernel file timestamps put the mtime one second earlier in about 0.9% of writes (measured 345 of 40000). Passed in rounds 2-3 and in 6 of 6 local reruns; scripts/run-bench-cloud and the test are byte-identical to main.
failures.evidence: gate log FACTORY_TEST_FAILURE {"failing": ["benchmark"]} and the pytest E-lines at test line 19800; reproduction of the coarse-mtime miss rate with 40000 write/stat pairs on the devbox kernel (345 misses).
failures.assigned_reason: The deploy owner keeps the repair: rerun the full gate on the same source; the timestamp-slack fix ships as a follow-up because any source change reruns every gate.

failures.description: smoke: the campaign was stopped by its INFRA STOP (1/14 confirmed infrastructure failures) at r001-j0004 and r001-j0014, which both died in 9 s with "cleanup reserve admission failed: [Errno 28] insufficient physical cleanup floors for pending controllers": this devbox's disk was at 92% because of the 12 obsolete local worker checkouts (48 GB) this deploy had created. Deploy-execution condition owned by this deploy, not a task result; the remaining jobs were cancelled by their owned teardown.
failures.evidence: campaign cli.log lines 240-261 and runs/*/r001-j0004 log line 68; df showed 8.6 GB free; /home/boxes/dw (12 workers) removed afterwards (54 GB free).
